candidates.change_summary: Remove the body of withdrawAll so that it does nothing, changing the balance transfer behavior.
Delete the require check in onlyOwner, removing access control so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier, removing access control.
Replace the transfer call with payable(owner).transfer(_value), sending funds to the owner instead of msg.sender.
Replace the transfer call with a call to address(0).transfer, effectively burning the funds.
Replace the transfer call with payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance), ignoring the _value parameter and withdrawing the entire balance.
Replace the low-level call with a transfer call, which forwards only 2300 gas and reverts on failure, changing behavior for recipients with complex fallbacks.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call sendMoney and change the state.
Remove the revert on failure, so sendMoney succeeds silently even if the external call fails, thus changing `sendMoney`'s observable effect (no revert).
Delete the entire body of sendMoney, making it a no-op that never sends Ether and never reverts.
Replace the onlyOwner check with `require(true)` so anyone can call owner-restricted functions including sendMoney.
Delete the require statement, making the modifier always pass and opening sendMoney to anyone.
Swap the order of arguments to send Ether to msg.sender instead of _target, drastically changing who receives the funds.
